<!-- This card is the extension's own social preview, generated by the
extension itself — the avatar is one of the example cards. -->

To regenerate, render it then rasterize the `.typ`:

```bash
quarto render _thumbnail.qmd
```

```bash
quarto typst compile _thumbnail.typ thumbnail.png --font-path .quarto/typst/fonts --ppi 144
```
